label: product launch workforce process: Orchestrate sales compensation adjustments — Calculate and apply compensation adjustments based on successful product launch performance and sales achievements.

args.content:
## Landscape Summary
- 10 systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

## ⭐⭐⭐ PRODUCT LAUNCH SALES COMPENSATION ADJUSTMENTS
- **sap.sf:agent:CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1** - BEST FOR SALES COMPENSATION: Automates compensation policy enforcement and salary adjustments based on organizational rules; processes compensation events triggered by performance outcomes; related entity types: Compensation, Employee; tags: compensation, automation, payroll, policy-driven

## ⭐⭐⭐ PRODUCT LAUNCH WORKFORCE PROCESS (CAPABILITY/TRAINING)
- **sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1** - BEST FOR WORKFORCE IMPACT & TRAINING/REDEPLOYMENT: Monitors employee competencies and engineering change requests; processes material and product item requirements; evaluates capability gaps; recommends targeted development or reassignment actions; tags: workforce-optimization, capability-planning, resource-orchestration
- **emarsys.cx:agent:ProductLifecycleOrchestrator:v1** - SECONDARY: Automates product change coordination and inventory synchronization; triggers customer engagement campaigns; processes product lifecycle transitions (less focused on workforce training)

## ⭐⭐⭐ PRODUCTION QUALITY MONITORING (MANUFACTURING EXECUTION)
- **my.mes:agent:ProductionQualityMonitor:v1** - BEST FOR MANUFACTURING QUALITY METRICS: Monitors QualityInspection outcomes across ProductionOrders; detects quality deviations and defect rates; triggers corrective actions; related entity types: QualityInspection, ProductionOrder, Machine; tags: quality-monitoring, autonomous-control, defect-detection, production-optimization

## ⭐⭐⭐ ENGINEERING CHANGE SPECIFICATIONS RETRIEVAL
- **siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1** - BEST FOR ENGINEERING CHANGE SPECS: Automates engineering change processing; coordinates changes across product items and materials; synchronizes configuration updates; related entity types: EngineeringChange, Material, ProductItem; capabilities: coordinate-bom-updates, synchronize-engineering-changes, evaluate-change-impact, track-change-status, manage-material-provisioning

## ⭐⭐⭐ CUSTOMER SAFETY COMPLIANCE VERIFICATION
- **sap.ehs:agent:ComplianceCampaignOrchestrator:v1** - BEST FOR CUSTOMER SAFETY COMPLIANCE: Automates safety compliance campaigns across customer segments and accounts; monitors campaign effectiveness; coordinates regulatory compliance initiatives; orchestrates targeted safety interventions based on customer account risk profiles

## ⭐⭐⭐ EQUIPMENT MAINTENANCE SAFETY RISK ANALYSIS
- **sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1** - BEST FOR EQUIPMENT MAINTENANCE SAFETY: Coordinates safety incident workflows & emergency response

## ⭐⭐⭐ PROCUREMENT INVOICE RECONCILIATION (VENDOR INVOICES ONLY)
- **sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1** - Matches vendor invoices to POs and contracts; three-way matching logic; validates line-item quantities, pricing, terms

## ⭐⭐⭐ PRODUCT LAUNCH SUPPLIER QUALIFICATION
- **siemens.plm:agent:SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1** - BEST FOR MATERIAL & VENDOR QUALIFICATION: Coordinates supplier qualification processes and material approval workflows

## GAPS IDENTIFIED
- NO resource for "SafetyComplianceCostReconciliation" - combining safety/compliance costs with customer invoices and material usage
- NO resource for "ComplianceFinancialImpactAnalysis" - quantifying financial impact of safety activities vs revenue
- NO integrated resource for employee performance against manufacturing standards (availability: ProductionQualityMonitor for quality metrics only; Performance review/compensation agents for HR only; no dual-tracking resource)
